newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says 29 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says 29 Kurd rebels killed in clashes.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 29 Kurdish rebels in fighting in the southeast of the country over the last week, state-run Anatolian news agency said on Monday.
The emergency rule governor's office said in a statement that three soldiers and one member of the state-sponsored "village guard" militia died in the clashes.
The deaths occurred in seven separate clashes over the week in the rugged mountains of Turkey's southeast.
More than 26,000 people have died since 1984 in an armed conflict between the military and the PKK, fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
